spec2def(hid.dll hid.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# The HID parser is hidparser-rust, built for user mode (its `user` panic personality).
rust_staticlib_variant(hid_hidparser_rust hidparser-rust "user" FALSE)

# hid.dll is all Rust (hid-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/hid-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# hid.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/hid-rust/src/hid/hid.rs)
# hid.c includes the parser's hidp.h, which the C static lib used to export as its interface.
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(hid_shims OBJECT rust_varargs_shim.c)
target_compile_definitions(hid_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(hid_res OBJECT hid.rc)
target_compile_definitions(hid_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(hid_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
target_include_directories(hid_shims PRIVATE ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/lib/drivers/hidparser)
target_include_directories(hid_res PRIVATE ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/lib/drivers/hidparser)
add_cargo_module(hid hid-cargo hid.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE hid-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS hid_shims hid_res)
